What You’ll Do

Own the end-to-end product execution for clinical studies run through Elfie, ensuring each study is flawlessly designed, launched, and tracked to meet scientific and operational objectives

Bridge the clinical and consumer worlds by translating study protocols into engaging, user-friendly product experiences that align with patient needs and behavior

Customize Elfie’s features —including health programs, wellness journeys, and engagement mechanisms—to meet the specific requirements of each research protocol

Collaborate closely with clinical researchers, scientific advisors, and external study partners to ensure product compliance with study standards and ethical guidelines

Work directly with the internal Elfie Research business unit to support broader goals such as generating publishable outcomes and advancing Elfie’s scientific credibility

Define study-specific product flows and data tracking logic , aligning with clinical endpoints, compliance needs, and user retention goals

Ensure on-time delivery across cross-functional teams including product, content, engineering, data, and operations to meet study launch and reporting milestones

Continuously improve the research product experience , leveraging user insights and operational feedback to strengthen adherence, data quality, and study success

What You’ll Need

Product & project management

5+ years of experience in product or program management, ideally in digital health, clinical research, or healthcare technology

Proven ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder projects from scoping to execution, under strict timelines

Demonstrated experience delivering user-facing features or workflows with measurable outcomes

Clinical study understanding

Strong familiarity with clinical study protocols, trial phases, and compliance considerations (GCP, informed consent, etc.)

Experience working with or supporting clinical operations, digital health research, or patient-centered trials is a strong plus

User-centered product thinking

Ability to translate scientific requirements into intuitive, engaging user journeys and behavior-supportive product flows

Skilled in customizing existing product systems (e.g., programs, engagement tools) to align with research-specific needs

Cross-functional & stakeholder collaboration

Excellent communication skills in English, with experience working directly with clinical researchers, external partners, and internal stakeholders

Comfortable aligning product, data, content, and engineering teams toward common study objectives

Technical & analytical fluency

Comfortable working with data teams to define tracking frameworks for clinical endpoints and user activity

Proficiency in tools like Figma, Notion, and product analytics platforms is a plus

Preferred Background

Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Product, Public Health, Life Sciences, Engineering, or similar); advanced degree is a plus

Experience in early-stage startups or health-tech environments is preferred

Why Join Elfie?

We're a global start-up that ismission-led, and fiercely product-driven.

We're building something that improves lives - and we're doing it with a culture of trust, freedom, and high performance.

About Elfie

Elfie is the first completely free, gamified mobile app that rewards users for managing their health. Our goal? To become the world’s largest self-reported medical record platform — across all therapeutic areas.

We operate in 10+ countries today, with plans to expand into 15 by the end of 2025.

Job description

Somos uma empresa 100% digital, com tecnologia desenvolvida localmente e líder no mercado de compra e venda online. Nos tornamos a marca que melhor representa a economia circular no país.

Hoje contamos com dois escritórios nas cidades de Rio de Janeiro e São Paulo. Nosso modelo de trabalho flexível oferece autonomia e liberdade para que nossas pessoas elaborem seus padrões e rotinas com disciplina e protagonismo na conexão com negócio, as prioridades e o propósito da empresa.

Construir um ambiente diverso, inclusivo e comprometido com a equidade faz parte do nosso DNA. Entendemos que diversidade, equidade e inclusão são essenciais para criarmos um ambiente seguro com entregas inovadoras e eficientes para nossas pessoas e sociedade.


Main responsibilities

Se você gosta de aprender e quer fazer parte desse desafio, essa oportunidade éa sua chance. Nessa posição deAnalista de Faturamento Sênior,você vai somar ao time Finanças que tem comoobjetivo Garantir a assertividade da receita bem como as rotinas de Faturamento e Contas a Receber.

No dia a dia você vai:

  • Garantir que as áreas especialistas tenham conhecimento dos insumos necessários para o reconhecimento da receita (competência, valor das campanhas, pedidos de inserção, etc.), por meio de reuniões semanais;
  • Garantir a aderência ao cronograma de faturamento, com reuniões semanais para cumprimento dos prazos da empresa;
  • Garantir a assertividade na contabilização da provisão de receita, faturamento e ajustes, acompanhando relatórios sistêmicos e gerenciais;
  • Executar as rotinas de faturamento e contas a receber (receita nacional e internacional), acompanhando e ajustando os prazos e prioridades estipulados pela empresa;
  • Atuar nas renegociações dos contratos da área de Faturamento;
  • Apoiar as demandas da auditoria interna e externa;
  • Acompanhar e atuar de forma proativa nas metas (OKR), através de solicitações e implantações de melhorias em sistemas e processos (integração da receita de vendas online para o ERP, implantação da ferramenta de conciliação de recebimentos, enriquecimento da base do ERP com informações da receita por vertical, etc.);
  • Elaborar e atualizar os arquivos com relatórios da área (Taxa de Conversão, Prazo Médio de Recebimento, Receita por Vertical, etc.);
  • Garantir o fechamento mensal da receita e realizar as validações necessárias para assegurar que as informações financeiras sejam refletidas de forma integral no balanço;

Requirements and skills

E o que você precisa ter?

  • Atuação com área Administrativa e/ou Financeira;
  • Formação: Ensino Superior completo em áreas de Exatas (Economia, Contabilidade, Administração, Engenharia, Atuária, etc.);
  • Experiência: Faturamento, contas a receber, garantia de receita e conhecimento em processos de reconhecimento de receita e recebíveis;
  • Ferramentas: Domínio do Pacote Office e sistemas ERP;
  • De 4 a 6 anos de experiencia em Faturamento.

O que será um diferencial?

  • Pós-graduação: Desejável especialização (MBA, Mestrado, Doutorado) em Finanças.

Additional information

Mais sobre o Grupo OLX:

No Brasil desde 2010, o Grupo OLX tem como propósito empoderar as pessoas para que alcancem seus sonhos, reinventando o modelo de consumo. Com a aquisição do Grupo ZAP, concluída em outubro de 2020, a companhia opera a OLX, plataforma horizontal com posição de liderança nas categorias de automóveis, bens de consumo usados e imóveis; e duas plataformas líderes do mercado imobiliário, ZAP e Viva Real.

Ceragon (NASDAQ: CRNT) is a global innovator and leading solutions provider of end-to-end wireless connectivity, specializing in transport, access, and AI-powered managed & professional services. We empower customers to enhance operational efficiency and enrich end-user experience through our innovative solutions.

Our clients include service providers, utilities, public safety organizations, government agencies, energy companies, and more. They rely on our expertise in 5G & 4G broadband wireless connectivity, mission-critical services, and applications leveraging ultra-high reliability and speed. Ceragon solutions are deployed by over 600 service providers and 1,600 private network owners across more than 130 countries.

Our end-to-end solutions, encompassing hardware, software, and managed & professional services, enable customers to confidently adopt future wireless technologies, shaping next-generation connectivity and service delivery. Responsabilidades Da Posição
A Drogaria Venancio busca um Assistente de Contas a Receber para se juntar à nossa equipe financeira . Nossa equipe é dinâmica e inovadora , e estamos procurando por alguém que compartilhe nossa paixão por excelência . Como Assistente de Contas a Receber, você será responsável por recebimentos de valores , apuração de valores e realização de encontro de contas .
Se você é uma pessoa organizada , detalhista e com experiência em contas a receber, nós queremos ouvir de você ! Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho acolhedor e oportunidades de crescimento .

Sobre a Empresa
Cuidando de você, sempre!
Somos a Drogaria Venancio, uma marca carioca que, há mais de 45 anos, coloca o cuidado no centro de tudo o que faz. Com mais de 135 lojas físicas e ao mesmo tempo mais de 4.900 colaboradores, estamos presentes em diversos bairros do Rio de Janeiro e municípios como Niterói, São Gonçalo, Duque de Caxias, Angra dos Reis, Nova Iguaçu, São João de Meriti, Petrópolis, Teresópolis, Búzios e Volta Redonda.
Além disso, nossos canais digitais ampliam nossa atuação para mais de 10 estados, levando saúde, beleza e bem-estar a milhares de clientes em todo o Brasil.
Nosso propósito? Cuidar das pessoas de forma acessível, humanizada e inovadora. Acreditamos que saúde vai além dos medicamentos: é qualidade de vida, prevenção e bem-estar.
Em 2014, criamos a Hospinova, empresa do Grupo Venancio focada no mercado hospitalar e na distribuição farmacêutica, garantindo um serviço especializado e eficiente. Para sustentar nosso crescimento, contamos com três Centros de Distribuição, estrategicamente localizados no Rio de Janeiro, Espírito Santo e Belo Horizonte.
O que nos torna únicos? Nossa essência carioca, o acolhimento genuíno e a busca constante pela inovação. Valorizamos o capital humano, investimos na capacitação de nossos times e ganhamos com ética, transparência e simplicidade. Aqui, cada cliente é prioridade e cada detalhe importante.
A Venancio não para! Até o final de 2025, inauguraremos mais 23 lojas e continuaremos expandindo nossa presença no mercado, sempre com o compromisso de oferecer atendimento de excelência e soluções completas para o bem-estar de nossos clientes.
Se você compartilha da nossa paixão por cuidar de pessoas, venha crescer com a gente!

Join to apply for the Data Center Operations Engineer - Rio de Janeiro - Onsite role at Microsoft

As a Critical Environment Field Service Engineer , you would be responsible for overseeing the maintenance and operation of all machinery that supports the critical load inside a Data Center.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more, and we’re dedicated to this mission across every aspect of our company. Our culture is centered on embracing a growth mindset and encouraging teams and leaders to bring their best each day. Join us and help shape the future of the world.

Responsibilities

  • Oversee the day-to-day operations and maintenance of mechanical and electrical equipment in our leased Datacenters (MOP/SOP/EOP review, RCAs, FMEAs, change governance, and risk mitigation)
  • Maximize Critical Environment (CE) availability in conjunction with our Landlord partners at our leased Datacenters and to ensure optimal operational efficiency
  • Reduce high-impact and human-error Critical Environment (CE) incidents year over year
  • Deliver on cost/energy efficiency initiatives
  • Support delivery of the Datacenter’s Emergency Preparedness and Response plans and act as an escalation point for all facilities-related issues within our leased datacenters
  • Coordinate, plan, schedule, and supervise CE audits and compliance verification as needed
  • Ensure routine reporting to effectively manage and analyze our Power/Temperature/Relative Humidity, and SLA monitoring
  • Establish and enhance strong working relationships and engagement with our Engineering Groups (EGs), and Landlord partners (including contributing to MBRs, QBRs)
  • Work with regional and global peers to share and build best practices across the entire datacenter portfolio
  • Flexibility to work non-business hours that may include weekends and/or holidays during CE disruptions and critical incidents

Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in a Datacenter or other critical environment facility, working with the operation of building cooling, electrical, mechanical, and life safety systems, Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS), Branch Circuit Monitoring (BCM), Building Automation Systems (BAS), and Battery Monitoring Systems (BMS)
  • Technical College degree in Electrical/Mechanical Engineering or related field.
  • Able to communicate well in English and Portuguese in both written and spoken form.
  • Able to work 100% on site in Rio de Janeiro.

MacGregor is a global company that operates in 30 countries with 2000 employees. We provide sustainable cargo and load handling with a strong portfolio of products, services, and solutions to the maritime and offshore industries. Our solutions are found in over half of the world's merchant fleet.

We believe MacGregor is a great place to work and we are looking for innovators with an international mindset to join our team and help us create lifetime value for our customers.

MacGregor – Let's shape the future together

Are you driven by problem solving? Do you thrive working with complex and large equipment? Looking no further, MacGregor is looking to hire a Service Technician with either electrical, automation,software, mechanical or hydraulic competence.

The purpose of this role is to execute service, repair and maintenance work, such as diagnostics, troubleshooting, repair of advanced equipment on the MacGregor product range, plus 3rd party makers if needed.

We are looking for a candidate with previous experience working with products such as deck machinery,steering gears or cranes, but not limited to. As a person you are customer-oriented, cooperative, and have good communication skills, with the ability to effectively share information within the team.

This is a position that requires that you travel to client sites, vessels or at shipyards worldwide. Our clients are primarily domestic but also spread across the globe, i.e. Europe, the US, China, Australia, Singapore, and beyond. Therefore, flexibility and a strong willingness to travel is essential. Our office and workshop is located in the Rio de Janeiro area where you might be assigned to local work if needed, therefore it is essential that you live around Niterói and São Gonçalo Cities.

This role is part of our Global Services Division. Reporting directly to the Operations Superintendent.

More tasks and responsibilities

  • Carrying out planned and corrective maintenance/repairs, including onboard inspections
  • Driven to continuously improve and remain informed on relevant developments, routines, processes and news
  • Provide information and write reports in English language as required
  • Follow all site safety rules, agreed working practices and environmental requirements

What you’ll need to succeed

  • Technical education at Technical College level within Mechanical, Hydraulic, Electrical or Automation
  • Minimum 2 years of experience onboard in deck machinery, steering gears or cranes
  • Ability to work with a flexible daily schedule and be available for short-notice travel assignments
  • Proven experience working with computer systems professionally
  • Proficient in English language - both verbal and written

Why MacGregor?

Our people are behind every success. People create the technology and product lifecycle solutions that make us great, our people are the ones who innovate, and people drive our business forward. With us you will be part of an international collaborative working culture with challenges and opportunities to further develop yourself professionally. We enable sustainable global maritime operations by maximizing efficiency in cargo and load handling.

  • Integrity steers all our thinking, behaviour and the relationships with our customers and other stakeholders
  • Quality is valued in our processes, products and services and helps to improve our customers’ performance and our own competences
  • Safety is essential in everything we do

MacGregor is an equal opportunity employer. We recognise that diversity is key to our continued success, and strive to maintain a fair and equitable recruitment process for all applicants

Additional information

If you are ready to step into an exciting new role where you can make a significant impact and contribute to the success of MacGregor, apply today!

Kindly note that we will only review CVs and applications submitted in English.

Join to apply for the FONOAUDIÓLOGO - CER CENTRO role at SPDM/PAIS - Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde

A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de caráter filantrópico, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e municipal, conforme decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

Atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, promovendo ações de saúde e educação, além de ser organização social habilitada em diversos estados, gerenciando serviços de saúde via convênios e contratos de gestão.

A missão da SPDM é atuar na promoção da saúde, prevenção de doenças e tratamento, reforçando o compromisso social de atender a todos sem discriminação. A instituição busca expandir suas atividades na assistência social e educação, consolidando-se como uma grande organização filantrópica sustentável em aspectos econômicos, sociais e ambientais.

Sua estrutura inclui as superintendências do Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação, gerenciadas por profissionais altamente capacitados.

O PAIS iniciou suas atividades em 2001 em São Paulo, expandindo-se para outros municípios e estados, com foco na melhoria dos indicadores de saúde e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado na integralidade e equidade.

A SPDM também promove inclusão no trabalho, oferecendo oportunidades com plano de carreira para pessoas com deficiência, divulgando vagas periodicamente em jornais locais.

Missão: Promover ações em saúde integradas à gestão pública, beneficiando a população com ética, humanização, qualidade técnica, responsabilidade social e ambiental.

Visão: Ser referência na gestão de serviços de saúde, garantindo atendimento de qualidade em todos os níveis de assistência para os municípios e estados parceiros.

Valores:

  • Profissionalismo
  • Qualidade
  • Responsabilidade Social
  • Trabalho em equipe
  • Ética

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Executar métodos e técnicas fonoaudiológicas para auxiliar no desenvolvimento da fala, escrita e funções estomatognáticas, além de monitorar distúrbios da audição, motricidade ou facial, incentivando o aleitamento materno.
  • Realizar avaliação e diagnóstico de distúrbios de audição e fala, especialmente na emergência no CER CENTRO, desenvolvendo programas preventivos e ações corretivas.
  • Atuar em pesquisa, prevenção, avaliação e reabilitação das desordens da comunicação humana.
  • Realizar triagem auditiva e estimular o diagnóstico precoce em bebês internados.
  • Prestar atendimento de motricidade orofacial a recém-nascidos, incluindo teste da linguinha e promoção do aleitamento materno.
  • Avaliar condições clínicas para estratégias de estímulo à deglutição.
  • Realizar terapias e manobras para tratar problemas, promovendo segurança e qualidade de vida.
  • Atuar na promoção da saúde de crianças e adolescentes, avaliando causas e aplicando terapias.
  • Preencher formulários de avaliação e participar de ações de parceria com instituições de ensino, apoiando estágios, pesquisa e residência.
  • Contribuir para o desenvolvimento profissional de estagiários e residentes sob sua supervisão.
  • Observar princípios éticos na assistência ao usuário, incluindo procedimentos com estagiários, pesquisadores e residentes.
  • Participar de treinamentos e atividades de desenvolvimento oferecidas pelas instituições de ensino.
  • Seguir as políticas de conduta e proteção de dados pessoais, conforme LGPD.
  • Executar atividades conforme orientações do gestor e padronizações institucionais.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Graduação completa em Fonoaudiologia.
  • Pós-graduação em áreas como Audiologia, Linguagem, Motricidade Orofacial, Saúde Coletiva, Disfagia, Neurofuncional, Gerontologia ou Residência em Saúde.
  • Registro ativo no Conselho de Classe.
  • Experiência mínima de 6 meses em emergência/urgência, preferencialmente em UPAs, CER ou hospitais particulares.
  • Horário de trabalho: segunda, quinta e sábado, das 7h às 18h.

  • Local: Centro do Rio de Janeiro.

Talent Acquisition Partner @ Amagi I SaaS GTM Recruiting I MediaTech I AdTech I OTT I CTV

Amagi is a market leader in cloud-based media technology services for channel creation, distribution, and ad monetization. Amagi's cloud technology and managed services are used by TV networks, content owners, and CTV / OTT platforms to create 24x7 linear channels for OTT and broadcast distribution. Amagi delivers unified cloud solutions for channel creation, distribution, and advertisement via its lineup of versatile products, including Amagi CLOUDPORT and Amagi THUNDERSTORM.

Amagi's pioneering and market-leading cloud platform has won numerous accolades and is deployed in over 40 countries by 600+ TV networks. Customers of Amagi include A+E Networks, Comcast, Cox Media Group, Google, NBC Universal, Roku, Samsung, Warner Media, and many more.

This role provides a unique and transformative opportunity to grow a world-class technology organization by innovating how content is originated, distributed, and monetized. Amagi has offices in New York, Los Angeles, London, New Delhi, and Bangalore.

About The Role

As a Sr. Systems Engineer at Amagi, you will serve as a trusted advisor to our broadcast customers, leveraging your deep expertise in broadcast engineering and streaming technologies to address customer challenges and drive adoption of Amagi's cloud-based media technology solutions. You will be responsible for the technical aspects of the pre-sales process, ensuring seamless integration and alignment of our products with customer needs, while representing Amagi's innovative broadcast solutions in the market.

Key Responsibilities

  • Technical Leadership: Act as the primary technical resource for the sales team, providing expert guidance on broadcast automation, playout, live production, graphics, distribution, and streaming technologies
  • Solution Design & POCs: Collaborate with clients to understand their broadcast and streaming needs, design tailored solutions, and create customer-focused Proofs of Concept (POCs) with clearly defined success criteria
  • Pre-Sales Support: Lead technical discussions during the pre-sales process, including gathering customer requirements, conducting technical demos, and responding to Requests for Proposals (RFPs). Manage technical customer engagement and ensure a smooth handoff to the onboarding team
  • Product Expertise: Maintain deep knowledge of Amagi's products and services, including Amagi CLOUDPORT and Amagi THUNDERSTORM, to build and deliver curated demos, technical presentations, and training materials
  • Customer Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, acting as a technical advisor and ensuring their long-term success with Amagi's broadcast solutions
  • Industry Engagement: Represent Amagi at trade shows, conferences, and technical forums, demonstrating our product capabilities and staying current with industry trends and best practices
  • Feedback & Development: Gather and communicate client feedback to the product development team, helping to influence product enhancements and ensuring our solutions meet market demands.

Duties And Responsibilities

  • Manage Pre-Sales Engagements: Oversee multiple customer opportunities and related projects, prioritizing work and proactively escalating risks in consultation with the manager and sales teams
  • Single Point of Contact: Serve as the main technical contact for customers during the pre-sales process, engaging subject matter experts (SMEs) as needed for complex discussions or architecture reviews
  • Discovery & Documentation: Participate in discovery calls, accurately document customer requirements, and create technical Statements of Work (SOWs) for proposed solutions
  • Product Gap Analysis: Identify product gaps, create internal cases, and collaborate with the product team on feature requests and prioritization
  • Escalation Support: Provide technical support during customer escalations and collaborate with global internal teams during non-working hours if needed
  • Content Development: Develop technical collateral, including blog posts, training materials, and demos, to support internal and external enablement efforts
  • Continuous Improvement: Regularly provide feedback to enhance the pre-sales engineering process and improve product and technical documentation

Requirements

Education : Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent years of relevant experience.

Experience : 7+ years in media & entertainment technologies, with 5+ years in pre-sales engineering, solutions architecture, or broadcast engineering.

MUST have Technical Skills :

  • Subject matter expertise in broadcast automation, playout, live production, graphics, and distribution workflows

title: Analista de Segurança Eletrônica - Data Centers
description:
Who are we?

Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company, enabling connectivity to foster innovations that enrich our work, life, and planet.

We welcome bold ideas, value human connection, and offer opportunities for everyone to shape their future.

A career at Equinix means being at the forefront of shaping the future and enhancing customer value through innovation. You will collaborate across teams, influence decisions, and help define the path forward. Join us to find belonging, purpose, and a supportive team — because when you feel valued, you can do your best work.

Resumo da Posição

A equipe de Segurança Eletrônica é responsável por fornecer suporte técnico e operacional diário às operações de segurança física dos data centers, garantindo atendimento às metas de desempenho relacionadas à satisfação do cliente, disponibilidade, responsabilidade fiscal, capacidade de resposta e trabalho em equipe. Essa posição trabalha colaborativamente com diversas áreas internas e externas, como Cyber Security, Global Risk, IBX Operations, Design & Construction, Sales, Customer Care, entre outras, para atender às necessidades de segurança física e conformidade da empresa.

Responsabilidades

Ordens de Serviço

  • Apoiar instalações e desinstalações de segurança de complexidade moderada.
  • Gerenciar solicitações de trabalho não padronizadas, internas e externas, incluindo coordenação com fornecedores.
  • Acompanhar pedidos de segurança de clientes, incluindo requisitos de relatórios e auditorias.
  • Auxiliar na elaboração e distribuição de RFPs para projetos de infraestrutura de segurança.
  • Coordenar equipamentos auxiliares e realizar pequenos reparos para minimizar tempo de inatividade.

Gestão de Incidentes

  • Responder a incidentes de segurança no local de complexidade moderada.
  • Apoiar na elaboração de relatórios e análises de causa raiz.
  • Aplicar a matriz de decisão de incidentes de segurança e coordenar com o Equinix Operations Center (EOC).

Manutenção de Infraestrutura

  • Resolver problemas moderados relacionados ao sistema de controle de acesso (ACS) e sistema de gerenciamento de vídeo (VMS).
  • Realizar manutenção preventiva conforme procedimentos operacionais padrão.
  • Atender solicitações de suporte ao cliente, como auditorias e pedidos personalizados de segurança.
  • Gerenciar inventário de ativos e endereços IP de equipamentos de segurança.

Gestão de Fornecedores

  • Apoiar trabalhos de fornecedores relacionados a projetos de segurança voltados ao cliente e infraestrutura interna.
  • Coordenar com a equipe de gestão do site para atender requisitos de auditorias internas e externas.

Administração do Site

  • Garantir conformidade com processos e procedimentos de segurança e iniciativas de controle de qualidade.
  • Analisar e manter desenhos e documentação de suporte específicos do site.

Colaboração

  • Apoiar stakeholders durante atividades de manutenção.
  • Comunicar-se com equipes para coordenar instalações de segurança que impactam a infraestrutura.
  • Colaborar na implementação e validação de atualizações de sistemas.
  • Trabalhar com equipes multifuncionais em novas construções e expansões.

Requisitos

  • Vivência prática em instalação e manutenção de sistemas de CFTV e alarmes, com conhecimento técnico em cabeamento estruturado, redes IP e eletrônica aplicada à segurança física.
  • Experiência consolidada em ambientes operacionais, com atuação direta em projetos de infraestrutura de segurança.
  • Conhecimento substancial em procedimentos operacionais padrão de segurança física.
  • Capacidade de resolver problemas moderadamente complexos com julgamento e autonomia.
  • Habilidade para colaborar com diversas áreas e comunicar-se de forma eficaz.
  • Comunicação e compreensão do Idioma inglês será considerado um diferencial
  • Disponibilidade para atuar 100% presencialmente nos Data Centers da Equinix em São Paulo e Barueri.

Equinix está comprometida em garantir que nosso processo de recrutamento seja acessível a todos, incluindo pessoas com deficiência. Se você é um candidato qualificado e necessita de assistência ou acomodação, por favor, informe-nos preenchendo este formulário .

A Equinix é uma empregadora que promove a igualdade de oportunidades de emprego e, nos EUA, uma empregadora de Ação Afirmativa. Todos os candidatos qualificados receberão consideração para emprego sem distinção de raça, cor, religião, origem étnica, nacionalidade, sexo, gravidez, condições médicas relacionadas, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, estado civil, status de veterano ou militar, deficiência física ou mental, informações genéticas, filiação política/organizacional, condição de vítima ou familiar de vítima de crime ou abuso, ou qualquer outra condição protegida por lei aplicável.

About Donorbox
Donorbox is a leading fundraising platform and donor management system for nonprofit organizations. Our mission is to accelerate positive impact worldwide by helping nonprofits become highly effective at raising funds and managing their supporter base. Since 2014, we have powered more than 100,000 global organizations to close to $3B in donations.
Our fast-growing company is profitable and bootstrapped with a healthy run rate. We have a fully distributed and diverse 150-person team based in 16+ states and 23+ countries.
Donorbox is rated the #1 software for fundraising, donor management, and nonprofit payment on G2 based on hundreds of verified customer reviews. We're proud of what we do, and our product reflects it!
The Role
Donorbox is seeking a Product Analyst to join our growing team. Reporting directly to the Director of Product, the person will be a key player in helping our product teams make data-driven decisions. The role's primary focus will be on defining, implementing, and analyzing product metrics such as in-app events and conversion funnels. The person will also be responsible for ensuring the integrity and accuracy of our data collection, acting as a crucial link between our Product and Data departments. They will work closely with product managers and designers to provide the insights they need to build and iterate on successful features, and track the key results for each objective of every product team.
Responsibilities

  • Define and track key product success metrics across various product teams, including quarterly OKRs.
  • Work with product managers to establish, implement, and analyze product conversion funnels.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to ensure accurate and complete data collection for all new product launches and feature updates.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for product usage data requests from the design team, providing them with the necessary insights to inform their decisions.
  • Bridge the communication and technical gap between the Product and Data departments, translating business needs into data requirements.
  • Monitor data quality and integrity, troubleshooting and resolving any issues related to event tracking or data loss.
  • Assist in setting up and analyzing A/B tests and other experimental feature rollouts.
  • Prepare and present regular reports and dashboards on product performance to stakeholders.
Qualifications & Experience
  • Minimum 5 years of experience as a Product Analyst or in a similar data-focused role.
  • Deep expertise in web analytics platforms such as Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and Google Tag Manager (GTM).
  • Hands-on experience with advanced product analytics tools like Heap, Posthog, or Pendo, including successful implementation and ongoing use.
  • Experience with A/B testing and feature rollout platforms.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a keen eye for detail.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across different teams.
  • Proficiency in data visualization tools (e.g., Looker Studio, Tableau, Power BI).
  • Experience with SQL for data querying and analysis.
Bonus
  • Familiarity with data warehousing concepts and technologies.
  • Experience in a high-growth or startup environment.
  • Knowledge of scripting languages like Python or R for data analysis.
  • Background in user experience (UX) or product design.
  • Familiarity with agile development methodologies.
Details

  • Wellness program with fitness and mindfulness classes
  • Love your work and our mission of serving nonprofits!

title: Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer
description:
Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer

Join or sign in to find your next job

Join to apply for the Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer role at Canonical

Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer

1 day ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring a Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer to our Information Systems (IS) team. This role is an opportunity for an "automation-first" senior technologist with a passion for Linux to build a career with Canonical and drive the success with those leveraging Ubuntu and open source products. If you have experience of IT operations automation, Infrastructure as Code and a passion for technology, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.
Job Summary
The IS team at Canonical supports and maintains all of Canonical's IT production services. The team is in charge of running services used by over 60 million Ubuntu users.
As an Senior SRE & Gitops engineer you'll be in a unique position to drive operations automation to the next level, both in our own private clouds as well as in the public clouds. We do this by utilizing the best of open source infrastructure as code software, software development practices such as CI/CD pipelines, and Canonical's leading products for software operation automation.
In addition to defining the infrastructure as code, you will improve Canonical products and the open-source technologies they're based on by providing critical feedback to developers on how their products operate at scale. This is done by submitting bugs (and sometimes writing pull requests) and collaborating on design and implementations with other teams within the company.
You'll be part of a global team of SREs that work together and support each other to provide the best possible services to our company, Canonical's customers and the Ubuntu Community.
As a Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer you will

  • Drive the development of automation, Gitops in your team as an embedded tech lead
  • Closely collaborate with the IS architect to align your solutions with the IS architecture vision
  • Design and architect services that IS can offer to the organization as products
  • Apply your experience of IaC to develop infrastructure as code practice within IS by constantly increasing automation and improving IaC processes
  • Automate software operations for re-usability and consistency across private and public clouds, taking into consideration the complexities of distributed systems
  • Maintain operational responsibility for all of Canonical's core services, networks, and infrastructure
  • Develop skills in troubleshooting, capacity planning, and performance investigation, Setting up, maintaining and using observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and Elasticsearch; design, implement and maintain monitoring and alerting for various systems and services
  • Provide assistance and work with globally distributed engineering, operations, and support peers
  • Be given uninterrupted development time to focus on larger projects and automation of manual tasks
  • Share your experience, know-how and best practices with other team members in design sessions, mentorship and 'doing work together'
  • Carry final responsibility for time-critical escalations
What we are looking for in you
  • A modern view on hosting architecture, driven by infrastructure as code across both private and public clouds.
  • A product mindset thriving to develop products rather than solutions.
  • Python software development experience, with large projects
  • Experience working with Kubernetes or other container orchestration systems.
  • Proven exposure to manage and deploy cloud infrastructure with code.
  • Practical knowledge of Linux networking, routing, and firewalls
  • Affinity with various forms of Linux storage, from Ceph to Databases
  • Hands-on experience administering enterprise Linux servers
  • Extensive knowledge of cloud computing concepts and technologies
  • Bachelor's degree or greater, preferably in computer science or related engineering field
  • Able to communicate clearly and effectively in English over email, chat, video or voice calls and in-person
  • Motivated and able to troubleshoot from kernel to web, and willing to ask others when appropriate
  • A willingness to be flexible and able to learn new things quickly
  • Be inspired by the needs of fast-changing environments
  • Happy to work within distributed teams
  • Be passionate and familiarized about open-source, especially Ubuntu or Debian
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Data Scientist (Brazil) Rio de Janeiro
description:
place Oslo, Norway

Data Scientist

One year in Norway, a career in Brazil—grow with us across borders

calendar_today

About Solution Seeker

Solution Seeker - with headquarters in Norway and a subsidiary in Brazil - is a scaleup building software and AI for industrial production optimization, turning data into value and strategic insight for our users.

Our software streams live sensor data from production facilities worldwide, processed in an event-driven, distributed system using patented algorithms to identify stable periods and select the most valuable data points for our machine learning models.

On top of this, we develop applications that help customers visualize and contextualize their data with our predictions and analyses, enabling them to make better production decisions. Beyond client work, we dedicate significant time and resources to cutting-edge machine learning research, including generative and probabilistic modeling, hybrid modeling (combining physics and ML), data-driven production optimization, and closed-loop identification.

As a Data Scientist, you will work hands-on with our data and play a key role in addressing some of the most important technical and strategic challenges we face. Your tasks may include:

  • Analyzing large volumes of production data to solve real customer challenges
  • Developing and optimizing our machine learning models
  • Designing and building applications based on customer needs
  • Preparing and delivering insightful presentations internally and externally
  • Contributing to strategic initiatives such as go-to-market plans, positioning, and delivery models

You’ll develop both technical and business expertise in a growing scaleup, giving you a strong foundation for future growth, whether you aim to specialize technically, move into business roles, or step into leadership.

About you

In addition to being technically skilled, you are naturally curious and never back down from a challenge. You are generous and accountable, always seeking to include others rather than exclude them. Your playful nature and willingness to contribute to the work environment make you a valuable team member because you know that happy developers mean happy customers.

You thrive in a young, international, fast-paced environment where your passion for continuous learning and innovation drives your success. Join us and be part of a team that embraces curiosity, warmth, playfulness, and punchiness as we create groundbreaking solutions and strengthen our position as world-leading experts in our field

Requirements

  • Fluency in English and Portuguese , both written and spoken (English will be your main working language)
  • Willingness to live 12 months in Oslo, Norway (from Feb 2026) and return to Rio to join the Brazilian team once your initial rotation is over.
  • Interest in digitalization, machine learning, and AI
  • Basic understanding of programming and strong logical reasoning skills
  • Ability to take initiative and deliver results
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills
  • Being Brazilian or possessing a valid work permit to work in Brazil (once your rotation in Oslo is over)
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related field
  • Our tech stack is large and we do not expect you to know all of it, but any familiarity would be greatly appreciated skills
  • Familiarity with Python
  • Experience working with large datasets
  • Experience/knowledge of Plotly Dash
  • Experience studying or working abroad
  • Experience with simulation, optimization, and modeling
  • Master’s degree in engineering or a related field

What we offer

To give you the best possible start before joining our Rio de Janeiro team, you’ll spend your first year with us at our headquarters in Oslo, where you’ll get a full onboarding into the company, our people, and our way of working. We will provide assistance related to obtaining the necessary visas/work permits before you can relocate to Oslo, and we will offer a competitive remuneration package for your stay in Norway, so you can focus on learning, contributing to the company, and enjoying the experience.

At Solution Seeker, we believe work should be both meaningful and fun. You’ll have the freedom to shape your own workday, with opportunities to explore different teams and projects based on your interests.

Our culture is young, social, and collaborative—we enjoy lunch runs, after-work beers, company trips. Once back in Rio, you’ll carry that spirit with you, working closely with our Oslo team while enjoying the energy of our Brazilian office (and yes, the beaches are right there when you need them).

Unique and interesting projects – both locally and globally – will challenge you and allow you to pursue different and rewarding career paths.

We are #EnergizedByGrowth.

DFS is part of a legacy of leadership that spans back generations, made up of some of the most trusted, leading-edge brands in the industry. As part of Dover Corporation and with our talented, innovative, outstanding people, we are doing great things and redefining what is possible in fueling and convenience retail. Providing advanced fuel-dispensing equipment, including clean energy solutions, systems and payment, automatic tank gauging and wet stock-management solutions, DFS comprises the product brands of Wayne Fueling Systems, OPW Fuel Management Systems, ClearView, Tokheim, ProGauge, Fairbanks, LIQAL, AvaLAN, and Bulloch Technologies. Headquartered in Austin, TX, DFS has a significant technology development and manufacturing presence worldwide, including facilities in Brazil, China, India, Italy, Poland, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom and the United States.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for checking the accuracy of import/export recordkeeping.
  • Manage, request, and compile necessary import documentation to ensure entry accuracy.
  • Partner with different teams like sales and customer services teams on due diligence process, including but not limited to Know your customer, screening, and vetting.
  • Support local entity’s participation on FTA (Free trade agreement) under the guidance from Corp. compliance and partner with functional teams on the necessary supporting calculation and collection.
  • Partner with Engineering to ensure accurate Harmonized Tariff classifications, maintain internal classification databases and ensure accuracy of customs entries.
  • Assist in maintaining part databases with global trade compliance data including product classifications, HTS Codes, and country of origin classifications.
  • Audit Import entry data and manage any Post Entry Amendment requirements with the broker.
  • Coordinate audits to ensure import/export policies are followed and identify necessary corrective action plans to continuous improvement.
  • Manage the proper reporting of assists as related to Dover trade compliance policy.
  • Provide training with the support from corporate compliance team to local entities on different trade compliance topic.
  • General compliance support, including VC (screening tool), TPG (3rdparty vetting platform), code of conduct, conflict of interest, training etc.
  • Other duties pertaining to corporate compliance as assigned.

Qualifications/Experience Requirements:

  • Additional experience in supply chain, traffic, logistics, business is highly desired.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, with a positive, team-oriented approach.
  • Ability to assess risk and recommend actions and strategies to mitigate regulatory risks.
  • Self-starter with the ability to work independently on multiple tasks to meet deadlines, prioritize, and maintain flexibility in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
  • Experience in tariff classification and country of origin determination. Engineering background in HTS Classification is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of documentation requirements and Brazil Customs regulations.
  • Data analysis and Excel skills proficiency.
  • Brazil Customs Brokerage License not required, but highly desirable.
  • Impeccable ethics and trustworthiness.

Descrição da empresa

A SGS é uma Multinacional Suíça, líder mundial emInspeção, Verificação, Testes eCertificação, somos reconhecidos por nossa qualidade e integridade. Estamos presentes em mais de 140 países, com 99.600 colaboradores no mundo, contamos com2.650 escritórios e laboratórios. Nosso time no Brasil possui aproximadamente 4.000 colaboradores, distribuídos nas 5 unidades de negócios, sendo elas:

Indústrias e Meio Ambiente - Possibilitando infraestrutura, transporte e indústrias mais seguras, sustentáveis e ecológicas. Na SGS, fornecemos a gama mais abrangente do mundo de serviços integrados de inspeção, teste, certificação e consultoria, com tecnologia de ponta e ferramentas digitais. Nossa rede global de especialistas ajuda a indústria a navegar por uma ampla gama de novos padrões, regulamentos e responsabilidades corporativas.

Health & Nutrition – Trabalhamos para ampliar a segurança, qualidade e sustentabilidade dos produtos alimentares, de saúde e bem-estar. Os clientes precisam saber que os alimentos que ingerem, os medicamentos, os produtos cosméticos e de higiene que utilizam são seguros e não os prejudicam. Na SGS, oferecemos a mais ampla gama de soluções de teste, inspeção e certificação para as indústrias de ciência agrícola, alimentos, ciências da saúde e cosméticos e higiene.

Recursos Naturais – Possibilitando eficiência e sustentabilidade nas indústrias agrícola, de mineração, petróleo, gás e química. Os recursos naturais são essenciais para o desenvolvimento econômico e fundamentais para a vida cotidiana. Nossa rede global de especialistas oferece suporte com terceirização de laboratório, logística de commodities, geoquímica, metalurgia, sustentabilidade e soluções de inteligência de mercado para ajudar a reduzir riscos, tomar decisões informadas e garantir a integridade.

Conectividade e Produtos – Possibilitando produtos e serviços melhores e mais seguros. À medida que o mundo se torna mais conectado, marcas, fabricantes, varejistas e governos devem garantir a segurança, a qualidade e a conformidade regulatória de seus produtos e serviços. Fornecemos a gama mais abrangente do mundo de serviços de inspeção, teste, certificação e consultoria, com tecnologia de ponta e ferramentas digitais. Nossa rede global de especialistas oferece suporte em todas as etapas – desde o projeto, produção e conformidade regulamentar até a importação e exportação de mercadorias.

Business Assurance – Transformar os negócios e viabilizar o crescimento sustentável aprimorando conhecimento, habilidades e processos com certificação, auditorias de fornecedores, avaliações de sustentabilidade, consultoria e treinamento. Em uma economia cada vez mais globalizada, sua organização deve manter-se atualizada com as complexas obrigações regulatórias, padrões e melhores práticas para reduzir os riscos jurídicos, financeiros e reputacionais. Com a expertise e o conhecimento de nossa equipe, trabalhando com processos e ferramentas avançadas, ajudamos organizações a melhorar resultados, gerenciar riscos, cumprir mudanças regulatórias e adotar melhores práticas, além de capacitar, tanto o profissional autônomo ou in-company, através do SGS Academy.

Valorizamos a inovação, excelência e colaboração em tudo o que fazemos. Respeitamos e apoiamos a diversidade em todas as suas formas, vetando adiscriminação contra qualquer candidato a emprego devido à identidade ou expressão de gênero do indivíduo, orientação sexual, deficiência visível e/ou invisível, origem socioeconômica e/ou multicultural, condições de saúde, idade, religião, ou quaisquer características protegidas por lei. Temos orgulho de ser um empregador que oferece oportunidades iguais.

Se você tem como valores, integridade, espírito empreendedor e inovação, o seu lugar é aqui! Venha fazer parte do nosso time!.

  • Inspecionar estruturas metálicas e/ou estruturas de concreto para que o cliente tenha um direcionamento das tratativas
  • Planejar e Preencher Análise de Risco de Tarefa e Permissão de Trabalho Seguro, para mitigação de exposição ao risco de acidentes
  • Realização de Inspeção de Nível 1 e Nível 2 em Estruturas Metálicas, máquinas de pátio, transportadores de correias, carregadores de Navios e/ou Estruturas de Concreto, pier, tunel e viadutos

Qualificações

  • Técnico em mecânica e edificações

  • Um ambiente de desafios com muitas oportunidades de mudanças e transformações.

No Brasil, estruturamos um Comitê de Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão composto por representantes de diferentes áreas e cargos, pois acreditamos que essa agenda necessita de várias perspectivas e vivências. Nossa liderança é engajada e compreende seu papel na disseminação e prática dos nossos princípios de liderança, com o objetivo de sermos "a melhor empresa para se trabalhar do mundo". Reconhecemos nossa responsabilidade e necessidade de mudança, conscientes de que "Sucesso e crescimento trazem grandes responsabilidades". Nossos grupos de afinidade, formados por voluntários de várias unidades de negócio, participam ativamente na definição das estratégias de DEI, atuando como embaixadores dessa agenda e apoiando desde o Day 1. Os grupos incluem: BEN - Black Employee Network, , Glamazon (LGBTQIA+) e Pessoa com Deficiência.

Procuramos um profissional para atuar como Analista Sênior de Gestão de Contas, desempenhando papel crucial na equipe de Massive Vendor Recruitment (MVR), responsável por criar parcerias sólidas e acelerar o crescimento de fornecedores de alto potencial para nosso negócio.

O time de MVR trabalha em programas como Selection, Qualidade de Catálogo, Eficiência Operacional, Disponibilidade e Rentabilidade, colaborando com as equipes de Produtos e centrais para atingir nossos objetivos.

Desafios da Função:

  • Gestão de Fornecedores: Desenvolver planos personalizados de aceleração e crescimento para cada fornecedor.
  • Negociações e Planejamento: Liderar negociações de compras a médio e longo prazo, criar planos de investimento do fornecedor, incluindo orçamentos de vendas, resultados e marketing.
  • Estratégias e Análises: Estabelecer estratégias inovadoras, analisar dados de negócios e planejar ações de impulsionamento do desempenho dos fornecedores.
  • Promoções e Ofertas: Elaborar ofertas e promoções, identificando oportunidades de crescimento para nossos parceiros e para a Amazon.com.br.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Acelerar a aquisição de seleção relevante e promover o crescimento de cada fornecedor;

title: Aero Mechanical Field Service Engineer
description:
Would you like to lead a team to our customers in the field?

Would you like to be part of our Turbomachinery Process Solutions Product

Line?

Be part of a successful team

Our Turbomachinery & Process Solutions team provides industry-leading products and services that optimize the extraction, production and processing of energy. As a team with integrity, we create value with impactful decisions by effectively connecting ideas and people

Partner with the best

As a Aeroderivative turbine Mechanical Field Service Engineer, you will be the first point of contact for our global customers on-site.
You will be responsible for leading activities, people and HSE compliance to a high standard.
Safely accomplish the installation, maintenance and repair of Aeroderivative Turbines. The work includes but is not limited to borescope inspections, blade work, combustion/hot section replacements, engine swaps, and other types of maintenance tasks.
You will enjoy opportunities to develop your product knowledge and technical skills in a dynamic, innovative environment.

As Mechanical Field Service Engineer , you will be responsible for:

  • Providing technical direction for site activities to internal teams and skilled labor to ensure safety, compliance, and quality.
  • Perform all mechanical and hydraulic maintenance, repair or replacement of parts as directed
  • Use hand tools and small power tools to conduct general maintenance of Aeroderivative Gas Turbines
  • Execute hands-on job duties on site, including sub-contractor coordination and customer/internal communication
  • Troubleshoot complicated mechanical and hydraulic problems on variable pitch/ variable speed turbines
  • Overseeing, overhaul, troubleshooting and commissioning of Aeroderivative products at customer sites.
  • Leading in customer and contractor meetings to share and update action plans and to advise on technical solutions.
  • Ensuring internal training, compliance and quality documentation is updated, followed, and completed according to company standards.
  • Ensure all in-field activities carried out safely complying with company environmental health & Safety (EHS) guidelines and procedures

Fuel your passion

To be successful in this role you will:

  • Have a degree in Mechanical Engineering or a Technical level in Mechanics
  • Have an active CREA or CFT
  • Have previous experience of work as a mechanical technician on aircraft engines, aero-derivative engines or other types of turbine technology.
  • Good mechanical/technical and oral communication skills.
  • Demonstrate a good working knowledge of the installation and maintenance of rotating equipment. Bolting, Hydraulic Bolting, Flange Management, Small Bore Piping
  • Experience with gas turbines is also .
  • Have experience working in a mechanical role in an energy or oil and gas environment (or similar).
  • Display an impressive customer service- mindset and experience leading customers through tough decisions.
  • Be skilled at communicating complex technical information to customers and teams with varying levels of technical understanding.
  • Have a deep awareness of Health, Safety and Environmental compliance and potential risks.
  • Be a motivated self-starter and be able to make key decisions and innovate solutions.
  • Have a good English knowledge.

title: Senior Sales Representative
description:
The Senior Sales Representative drives sales performance for ABS’ maritime training offerings. The Sales professional should be comfortable with ambitious targets, managing customer and partner relationships, and coordinating with regional training centers to broker learning solutions that meet customer needs. The professional will be central in articulating the value of ABS’ innovative maritime training solutions, ensuring customer satisfaction, and leveraging industry insights to position and sell maritime client training.

What You Will Do:

  • Communicate the value of ABS training offerings to external customers, B2B partners, and internal collaborators.
  • Work with ABS regional academy managers to provide sales support and understand customer needs.
  • Own and manage relationships with ABS training customers and serve as the primary point of contact for sales.
  • Coordinate pre-sales and pre-delivery calls with training customers, leveraging subject matter experts and instructors when necessary.
  • Actively prospect and generate leads for maritime training customers and conduct on-site client visits.
  • Periodically attend training deliveries to better understand customer profiles and cultivate relationships.
  • Collaborate with other business development personnel within ABS to bundle and cross-sell training offerings to a wide range of ABS customers.
  • Strategically expand the buying relationship by identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling.
  • Review evaluation feedback from training participants, monitor and ensure customer satisfaction.
  • Respond to RFPs with proposals that highlight ABS’ strengths in delivering cutting-edge educational technology and compliance training.
  • Collaborate with teams across marketing, product management, and service delivery to ensure cohesive client strategies and high satisfaction levels.
  • Utilizes existing software and services for handling Client Relationship Management (CRM).
  • Provide support to consulting, development, and other sales groups as requested.
  • Attend events, client committees, and industry conferences to represent ABS and its training offerings.
  • Stay abreast of industry trends, particularly in alternative energy sources and digitalization.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Sales, Business, Marketing, Maritime Studies, or a related field.
  • Preferred, at least ten (10) years of robust sales experience preferred, within the international shipping industry, with a proven track record of managing and expanding client relationships.
  • Experience and proven ability to sell to training customers in a B2B, for-profit commercial training market.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Exceptional communication, negotiation, and presentation skills and strong organizational and project management abilities.
  • Willingness to travel to meet clients, attend industry events, and engage with stakeholders across various regions.
  • Understanding of the shipping industry’s operational and regulatory challenges.
  • Strong interpersonal and team skills, including functioning successfully in a cross-functional team.
  • Ability to gain a working knowledge of the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management System.

Reporting Relationships:

The Senior Sales Representative reports to a senior member of management within the ABS Learning Organization and has no direct reports.

Capacidade de gerar fluxo de caixa previsíveis a longo prazo.

Melhorar a sustentabilidade do mercado.

Join our Turbomachinery Team!

Partner with the best

Partner with the best

As a Quality Control Specialist, you will coordinate and oversee work at a field site, providing quality service to the customer. Your role may include sales, job design, execution, and follow-up activities. You will plan the job, including instructions to the crew and equipment used. You will coordinate and direct the activities of service operators, oversee equipment cleanup, repair, and preparation for the next job.

As a Quality Control Specialist, you will be responsible for:

Fuel your passion

  • Have experience in the quality sector within the industry.

  • Have strong analytical and problem-solving skills, along with good interpersonal and organizational skills.
  • Be a leader with excellent listening, project management, communication, and presentation skills.
  • Be able to work effectively with customers at all organizational levels.
  • Have advanced computer skills, including proficiency in Microsoft Office, and the ability to learn specialized BH applications and project management software like Primavera or Microsoft Project.

Desired

Work in a way that works for you

Working with us

Our people are central to our success. We invest in their health, well-being, training, and leadership development to bring out the best in everyone.

With operations in over 120 countries, we provide innovative energy solutions. Committed to achieving net-zero emissions by 2050, we seek passionate individuals to help us make energy safer, cleaner, and more efficient.

title: IT Procurement Administrator
description:
About Us
Airswift is the leading workforce solutions providerto the STEM industries.For over 40 years Airswift has been transforming lives through the provision of international workforce solutions to STEM industries. Today, we are an integrated team of over 900 employees across 37 countries, supporting over 8,000 contractors globally.
We are a people business – we transform lives through the world of work. We care about wellbeing, community engagement and our planet – we plant a tree for every person placed in a job globally! We have a passion for growth, including investing in the development of our people.
We support professionals looking for jobs with exceptional firms in the technology, construction and engineering sectors.
Role Description
We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented IT Procurement Administrator to support the IT department in managing third-party vendors, ensuring compliance with IT standards, and driving operational efficiency. This role is pivotal in maintaining strong supplier relationships, overseeing risk and compliance processes, and supporting procurement and security initiatives across the business.
The post holder will work alongside global colleagues in supporting the business and would be expected to work across multiple time zones, on a per-project basis. This position provides exposure to a broad range of IT-related projects and activities, and new technology introductions to the business.
Principle Accountabilities:
Vendor & Supplier Management
  • Manage relationships with third-party vendors delivering core IT solutions to Airswift.
  • Oversee the supplier onboarding process.
  • Ensure vendor compliance with contractual obligations and agreed SLAs.
  • Collaborate with suppliers to identify cost savings and eliminate inefficiencies.
  • Proactively monitor contract expiry dates to ensure timely re-negotiation and renewals.
  • Developing and implementing streamlined procurement processes for technology expenditure, ensuring consistent management of both new and renewal spending.
  • Track and analyze supplier performance using Excel and dashboard reporting tools.
  • Working in collaboration with the Quality Dept, provide regular ISMS performance reports for the Group IT Director and other stakeholders.
  • Monitor user access and IT licenses, ensuring timely deactivation of unused accounts.
IT Risk & Compliance
  • Oversee the IT Risk Management process.Including maintaining the Risk Register, coordinating Risk Review meetings, and monitoring risk treatment plans to ensure that these are deployed by the Risk Owners in a timely manner.
  • Identify and escalate potential risks in service delivery, performance, or spending that may impact IT or the wider business.
  • Lead the implementation and maintenance of policies and procedures aligned with ISO27001 standards.

Procurement & Budget Management

  • Support the development and implementation of streamlined procurement processes for IT expenditure.
  • Manage supplier costs in line with the IT budget and ensure transparency for cross-charging business units for usage.
  • Handle contract renewals for key IT services, ensuring cost-effective and aligned solutions.

Security & Awareness

  • Assist the Bids team with security questionnaires and compliance documentation.
  • Lead internal security awareness initiatives, including phishing campaigns and “Did You Know?” updates.
  • Lead the implementation and maintenance of relevant policies and standard operating procedures in line with ISO27001 requirements.
  • Develop and maintain training materials for the Information Security Management System (ISMS) and requirements of ISO27001.

Innovation & Collaboration

  • Work closely with internal stakeholders to promote innovation within the technology ecosystem.
  • Communicate relevant technology and security updates to the business to drive adoption and best practices.
  • Collaborate with the Quality Dept on matters relating to ISO27001 compliance and opportunities for improvement, such as those identified through internal audits.

Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:

  • Proven experience in IT administration, vendor management, or procurement support.
  • Strong understanding of IT compliance frameworks, particularly ISO27001 would be ideal.
  • Proficiency in Excel and dashboard reporting tools.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Analytical mindset with a proactive approach to problem-solving.
  • Experience with contract negotiation and supplier onboarding is a plus.

What we can offer you!

  • Attractive monthly base salary + performance bonus.
  • Genuine career progression opportunities, either locally or globally!
  • World-class training programmes and development opportunities.
  • Virtual Onboarding Events exclusively for new hires.
  • Team driven environment, supportive culture with a focus on work-life balance.
  • Career breaks available after one year.
  • Real time recognition through our employee reward platform.
  • Mental Health First Aiders to signpost you to support when you need it.
  • Yearly destination trips as part of our High Flyers program (Dubai, Buenos Aires, etc…)
  • Charity days for various important causes, such as Relay for Life and Earth Day.
Our Core Values:
  • Growth - In life and business, one must grow to flourish and achieve high ambitions. Growthrequires change, challenge, risk and sacrifice - we will always choose growth.
  • Life – Above all else, we value life. The quality of life, both in and outside of work, profoundly influences our well-being and our impact on the world.
  • Excellence - We deliver, holding ourselves accountable for results. Our customers see excellence in everything we do.
  • Integrity - We are ethical, open, honest and authentic. People trust us to do the right thing for the right reason.

description:
Job description

A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e municipal, conforme decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e educação, e como organização social habilitada em vários estados, gerenciando serviços e organizações de saúde por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A principal diretriz da associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde, voltada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e promoção da saúde em níveis primário, secundário e terciário, fortalecendo laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com crescimento institucional, a SPDM expande suas áreas de atuação com projetos em desenvolvimento na assistência social e na área educacional. Essa variedade de atividades consolida a SPDM como uma grande instituição filantrópica, buscando sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais altamente capacitados.

Assim, a SPDM contribui efetivamente para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando garantir universalidade e acesso à saúde, essenciais ao desenvolvimento humano e social. Para isso, combina tecnologia de ponta com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, apoiado por equipes multiprofissionais, incluindo enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades em 2001 em São Paulo, expandindo-se para outros municípios e estados. Desde então, busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, ampliar e consolidar os serviços de saúde oferecidos pelo SUS.

O programa tem como objetivo melhorar indicadores e a qualidade de vida da população, pautando-se pelos princípios de integralidade e equidade, com uma visão estratégica de gestão de serviços de saúde, através de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Periodicamente, publica anúncios recrutando esses profissionais nos principais jornais de São Paulo e municípios onde possui unidades.

Missão

Promover ações de saúde integradas à gestão pública, beneficiando a população de forma ética, humanizada, com qualidade técnica, compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços de saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis de assistência, garantindo atendimento de qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

Valores

  • Profissionalismo
  • Qualidade
  • Responsabilidade Social
  • Trabalho em equipe
  • Ética

Main responsibilities

Organizar a operação do serviço de enfermagem, garantir o bom andamento dos serviços, orientar pacientes, controlar salas, equipamentos e leitos disponíveis, além de orientar a equipe técnica.

Atender às normativas do COREN, garantir o cumprimento de rotinas, normas e protocolos institucionais e de SMS, prestar assistência de enfermagem ao usuário desde a admissão, acompanhar o atendimento técnico, atuar como facilitador nos processos de enfermagem, promover melhorias no processo assistencial, manter comunicação com o corpo clínico, garantir assistência humanizada e segura, promover treinamentos, auxiliar na certificação profissional, gerir notificações de não conformidades, controlar estoque de materiais, preencher registros específicos, assegurar uso adequado de equipamentos, atender às normas de biossegurança, participar de ações de parceria com instituições de ensino, apoiar o desenvolvimento de estagiários e residentes, e cumprir as políticas de conduta e LGPD da instituição.

Requirements and skills

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Enfermagem
  • Especialização em Urgência e/ou Emergência
  • Registro ativo no conselho de classe
  • Experiência mínima de 6 meses na função de enfermeiro em urgência/emergência, em UPAs ou CER
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar de segunda a sexta-feira, das 13h às 19h, carga horária de 30h semanais

Additional information

description:

Nossas tecnologias líderes e nossa capacidade de aplicá-las com segurança e criar valor de forma eficaz para nossos clientes e acionistas.

Como Mandrilhador I, você será responsável por:

TAREFAS DIÁRIAS

  • Realizar reunião de pré-trabalho, preenchendo formulário e check list, fazendo a leitura dos procedimentos e documentos para realização da operação, com o objetivo de identificar se os itens necessários para a execução da atividade estão disponíveis.

  • Realizar movimentação de peça para a máquina, utilizando ponte rolante, talha, cintas, olhais, correntes e manilhas, seguindo os procedimentos de segurança e isolando a área.

  • Preparar peça na máquina - fixar a peça na mesa da mandrilhadora de acordo com as informações fornecidas pela Engenharia Industrial (Doc.: folha de preparação), garantindo que a peça não se mova durante a operação de usinagem.

  • Realizar o isolamento da área, seguindo os procedimentos de segurança.

  • Realizar captura dos pontos zeros inserindo a captura dos pontos zeros conforme informado pela Engenharia industrial, utilizando relógios apalpadores, comparadores ou cabeça Probe. Essa atividade é feita para garantir que as coordenadas do programa CNC estejam de acordo com o posicionamento geométrico da peça.

  • Realizar zeramento de ferramentas - encostar a ferramenta na peça ou com bloco padrão entre a peça e a ferramenta para realizar o zeramento. Inserir os valores na máquina de forma manual com o objetivo de determinar o ponto de início (ponto zero) da ferramenta com relação a peça, para realizar a usinagem.

  • Realizar operação de usinagem em mandrilhadoras Wotans - a usinagem das peças é feita conforme sequência pré-definida no programa CNC. Serão realizadas operações de fresamento, furação, rosqueamento e usinagem de perfis internos com ferramentas especiais, transformando a matéria prima nas dimensões especificadas no projeto do cliente.

  • Realizar inspeções das medidas usinadas fazendo uso de instrumentos de medição como: paquímetro, micrômetro, súbito, tubular, ball-gage, relógios entre outros, assegurando que não sejam fabricadam peças com dimensões que estejam fora da especificação no projeto do cliente.

  • Realizar usinagem utilizando cabeçotes angulares - deve-se fixar cabeçote angular na máquina, inclinando de acordo com as determinações da Engenharia Industrial, para realizar operações em ângulos, graus, em diâmetros internos de difícil acesso.

  • Curso de Fresador CNC

  • Controle dimensional

  • Identificar e registrar findings de segurança
  • Identificar e sugerir melhorias do processo
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em turnos
  • Conhecimentos em Tolerâncias Geomêtricas (GD&T)

Características desejadas:

  • Manuseio e transporte de peças com ponte rolante
  • Conhecimentos básicos nos softwares: Oracle, Epims, Gensuite, Manusis
  • Conhecimento em ferramental e consumíveis para os processos produtivos existentes

FARM é mais do que apenas roupas, é um estilo de vida despreocupado, abraçando a beleza natural e a confiança sem esforço em ser fiel a si mesmo. Valorizamos a cultura local e estamos sempre criando novas experiências para se conectar com o público. A natureza e a cultura brasileira servem como nossas maiores inspirações!

A FARM Global nasceu com o objetivo de expandir os horizontes e conquistar o mundo com as cores e a paixão única do Brasil! Já deixamos a nossa marca nos Estados Unidos e agora o foco é conquistar a Europa em 2022!

A área de Operações exerce um papel fundamental na evolução contínua da companhia, buscando garantir excelência no atendimento ao cliente, desde o primeiro contato.

Nosso time está crescendo e precisamos de pessoas analíticas, com boa capacidade de comunicação e apaixonadas pelo negócio para garantir o total funcionando da cadeia de operações, desenvolvendo análises, indicadores e melhorias nos fluxo, cumprindo prazos de pré-estabelecidos.
